title: Rav Zevid (I)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Nachman’s student, as in Bava Metzia 17a, where he disagrees with Rav Yosef bar Minyomi about how Rav Nachman said it.

In Bava Batra 23a Abaye raised a difficulty against Rav Yosef: “But was it not stated on this: Rav Mari said, ‘with smoke,’ and Rav Zevid said, ‘with an outhouse’?” In Avodah Zarah 14a: “Rabbi Yonah said that Rabbi Zeira said that Rav Zevid said.” He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:3: “Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Bun in the name of Rav Zevid: Once every seven years the Holy One, blessed be He, changes His world.” Hyman considers it very likely that he went up to the Land of Israel and was there called Rabbi Zevida; see his entry, contrary to Mavo HaYerushalmi.

notes.text: The proposed migration and Zevid/Zevida identification remain Hyman’s very-likely conjecture. The full supplied Rav forms and transmission chains are preserved.
The migration and identification with Rabbi Zevida are Hyman’s “very likely” conclusion, not an identity established by the consulted occurrence.
